No User.reload call is present in the served SignIn chunk or the automatic paths; the UserProfile chunk does not itself call reload. Editor b86dde8c5618 has no @clerk dependency or UserProfile/UserButton mount or direct user/session method call. packages/editor-core/server/account-service.ts:1217-1241 redirects to the account worker; share-session-gateway.ts:590,611 sends the shared-session visitor to that authorization URL. The pinned worker (vgai-engine db3fd7823a89; vgauth/spec/recordings/worker-source.txt:556-566,597-634,924-929) constructs GET authorize, exchanges/refreshes OAuth grants and reads Backend users/memberships; it mounts no profile UI.
